meta.title: Sorceress · Tarot Widget
meta.description: A witch in the corner of DSH: 7 position-aware tarot spreads (multi-card spreads require a question) with rich readings, a daily horoscope from real moon phase and three retrogrades, a mood diary with wish jar and breathing break, 13 auto-rotating standing poses, an encrypted archive for bazi, cycle and compatibility, plus a usage-bill panel. All assets inlined, no external process.
